concept: Blue/White Maid Lucario V41 — bonnet-only macroform pass 1

designIntent.firstRead: Only a rear-set soft maid bonnet. No dress, apron, sleeves, bow, ribbons or torso clothing in this pass.
macroRules: Do not alter any of the 87 official Lucario bones or their geometry.
Keep the forehead, eyes, muzzle and front crown visually open.
Place the bonnet behind the ear roots and over the rear crown.
Read as soft cloth wrap, never armor, crown, cage or helmet.
Use alpha-masked zero-thickness Bedrock planes for cloth contour.
Use overlap, taper, scallop and slight asymmetry to break orthogonal reads.
The front view must remain subtle; the three-quarter view carries the strongest bonnet read.
The side and rear views must connect into one continuous cloth silhouette.
Do not add any body garment until the owner approves this bonnet macroform.
referenceTechniqueCarryover: Use parented layered drape hierarchy rather than one monolithic rectangle.
Follow the existing head volume and ear-root negative space instead of replacing anatomy.
Use a primary cloth shell plus a subordinate ruffle edge so silhouette and trim have separate jobs.
designIntent.iterationNote: Bounded reset after the rejected full-outfit preview. This commit intentionally removes every V41 body garment from the scene seed and tests only the bonnet macroform. poly_mesh remains excluded from this preview because the current CI Blockbench codec path does not load Meshy; this pass uses documented zero-thickness Bedrock planes plus alpha contours so matched-camera evidence can be trusted. Owner approval is still required before any production promotion.
